question: According to Census of India 2011, which of the following states has a population of more than 10 crores?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the Census of India 2011, Maharashtra had a population of approximately 11.24 crores, making it one of the most populous states in India.
 
• The state's population density as per the 2011 census was 365 people per square kilometer.
 
• Maharashtra's urban population accounts for 45.2% of its total population, making it one of the most urbanized states in the country.
 
• Mumbai, the capital city of Maharashtra, is the most populous city in India with a population of approximately 12.4 million according to the 2011 census.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Census of India 2011:**

 
 
• The Census of India 2011 was the 15th National Census conducted in the country.
 
• It covered various aspects like population, housing, assets, and amenities.
 
• The data collected during the census is used for planning and policy formulation by the government.
 
 
 
• **Population Density:**
 
 
• Population density is defined as the number of people living per unit area, usually per square kilometer or mile.
 
• It helps in understanding the distribution of population across different regions.
 
 
 
• **Urbanization:**
 
 
• Urbanization refers to the population shift from rural to urban areas.
 
• It is associated with industrialization and modernization.
 
• Urban areas tend to have better infrastructure, amenities, and employment opportunities compared to rural areas.
 
 
 
• **Mumbai:**
 
 
• Mumbai is the financial, commercial, and entertainment capital of India.
 
• It is home to the Bombay Stock Exchange, one of the oldest stock exchanges in Asia.
 
• The city is also known for Bollywood, the Hindi-language film industry.
